assassin.note: A later Ninja is canonical, but this plan does not merge them without verification.

elf.known_fate: mortally wounded after Boa Constrictor; gives diamond clue if rescued

knight.known_fate: later recognized as a petrified statue

red_wizard.known_fate: recurring rival contestant; optional duel late in the dungeon
red_wizard.start: enters on Halvard's forfeited place trail

second_barbarian.note: Do not map every later generic Barbarian reference to Throm without passage-context verification.

throm.start: one of the two Barbarian contestants; enters before John

nodes.adaptation: Trial Gate / first physical corridor; optional aid box.
nodes.beat: Crystal-lit entrance tunnel; six boxes including one bearing the contestant's name.

nodes.adaptation: Optional aid pickup and first explicit hint that the dungeon is an item-dependent puzzle.
nodes.beat: Named box provides two gold pieces and Sukumvit's warning that several items will be needed.

nodes.adaptation: Physical fork with visible tracks and painted arrow.
nodes.beat: First major junction: white arrow points west; several footprints went west and one east.

nodes.adaptation: Short exploratory loop demonstrating that routes can reconnect.
nodes.beat: Eastern branch loops toward the soft obstruction / opening route.

nodes.adaptation: Second footprint fork; rivals function as moving breadcrumbs.
nodes.beat: Three sets of footprints divide: two west, one north.

nodes.adaptation: Puzzle room and first concrete evidence of a rival's fate.
nodes.beat: Old man's statue riddle; the player recognizes the petrified Knight who entered the Trial first.

nodes.adaptation: Throm physically joins John as a temporary companion.
nodes.beat: Player catches up with the Barbarian and travels west with him.

nodes.adaptation: Companion choice at a physical pit; preserve mistrust and cooperation.
nodes.beat: Uneasy temporary alliance with the Barbarian Throm; both know only one contestant may win; they reach a deep pit.

nodes.adaptation: Relationship branch: ally versus betrayal. The abandon route (149) is UNVERIFIED against the book.
nodes.beat: The Barbarian identifies himself as Throm. His distrust is visible while the player lowers him by rope.

nodes.adaptation: Walkable alcove where companion behaviour communicates personality.
nodes.beat: Two leather-bound books; Throm is contemptuous of reading and urges haste.

nodes.adaptation: Item experimentation with Throm reacting in-world.
nodes.beat: Black book contains an unknown potion; Throm refuses it and distrusts the unknown.

nodes.adaptation: Parallel encounter: Throm visibly occupies one troll while John enters a Duel Master battle with the other.
nodes.beat: Throm hears approaching footsteps first; two Cave Trolls arrive and each adventurer takes one.

nodes.adaptation: Companion commentary changes how a risky pickup feels without removing player agency.
nodes.beat: Throm has killed his troll but is wounded. A druidic bone ring is found; he refuses to touch it and advises against it.

nodes.adaptation: Major social/puzzle set-piece; Dwarf is controller, not a generic monster.
nodes.beat: Dwarf Trialmaster locks John and Throm in a chamber and says only one may continue. Throm proposes attacking him.

nodes.adaptation: Interactive Trialmaster mini-test rather than Duel Master combat. Passing it earns STONE.
nodes.beat: John persuades Throm to accept the Trialmaster's procedure; the Dwarf takes John through a secret door and begins a dice-probability test.

nodes.adaptation: Mandatory tragic Duel Master encounter; Throm is not a villain.
nodes.beat: The Dwarf later sends in a wounded, delirious Throm. The cobra has bitten him. John protests but must defend himself.

nodes.adaptation: Post-battle scene must preserve emotional consequence and the Dwarf's control.
nodes.beat: After Throm dies, John hates the Dwarf. The Dwarf keeps John at crossbow point and reveals the concealed way onward.

nodes.adaptation: Character death and crucial clue; her belongings become physical pickups.
nodes.beat: After rescuing the Elf from a Boa Constrictor, she is dying; she reveals that gems unlock the final door and identifies diamond as one required gem.

nodes.adaptation: Emerald objective room.
nodes.beat: Large idol cavern with fist-sized jewelled eyes and two stuffed bird-like guardians.

nodes.adaptation: Emerald acquired; tempting second eye remains dangerous.
nodes.beat: After the Flying Guardians are defeated, the emerald eye can be removed.

nodes.adaptation: Sapphire objective pickup.
nodes.beat: A box contains an iron key and a large sapphire.

nodes.adaptation: False-diamond temptation room.
nodes.beat: A room appears to contain a diamond beside a fallen warrior, but entering can be a lethal trap.

nodes.adaptation: Diamond objective acquisition.
nodes.beat: A later hall route allows the player to leave carrying the real diamond.

nodes.adaptation: Final checkpoint NPC; no generic battle unless player attacks.
nodes.beat: After the Manticore, Igbut the Gnome appears as final Trialmaster and checks for the three required gems.

nodes.adaptation: Preserve as a three-position Duel-Master-like logic lock rather than replacing it with combat.
nodes.beat: Final lock has three gem positions. Wrong arrangements cause injury; Igbut gives aggregate positional feedback and allows retries.

nodes.adaptation: Final sting before victory.
nodes.beat: After the final lock route, Igbut is killed by a final Sukumvit crossbow trap and John reaches daylight.

nodes.adaptation: Not a death ending.
nodes.beat: The Elf's bread contains healing herbs; the player packs away the mirror and charm and continues north.

nodes.adaptation: Dungeon completion / return to wider game.
nodes.beat: Victory: the surviving contestant emerges to Fang and is acclaimed as Champion.

premise.location: Fang / Baron Sukumvit's Trial of Champions
premise.structure: A deliberately lethal labyrinth with one successful route, traps, monsters, rival contestants and required items.
premise.video_game_translation: Dungeon run with permanent player knowledge/progression outside the run and run-specific dungeon state inside it.

roster.note: Five book contestants plus the Red Wizard plus John. Assassin and second Barbarian stay distinct from the later Ninja / Throm until verified.
